<function name="GetSquad" parent="NPC" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns the current squad name of the NPC, as set via <page>NPC:SetSquad</page>.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<added>2021.01.27</added>
	<rets>
		<ret name="name" type="string">The new squad name to set.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
